title: Writing systems: beyond the Latin script
intro: Name the script most commonly used to write each language.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Tamil?
questions.explain: Tamil is most commonly written in the Tamil script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Burmese?
questions.explain: Burmese is most commonly written in the Myanmar script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Armenian?
questions.explain: Armenian is most commonly written in the Armenian script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Sinhala?
questions.explain: Sinhala is most commonly written in the Sinhala script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Russian?
questions.explain: Russian is most commonly written in the Cyrillic script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Hindi?
questions.explain: Hindi is most commonly written in the Devanagari script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Persian?
questions.explain: Persian is most commonly written in the Arabic script.

questions.prompt: Which script is most commonly used to write Georgian?
questions.explain: Georgian is most commonly written in the Georgian script.
